cfg.description: CFG scale for the TTS model.

seed.description: Random seed. Omit or pass -1 to randomize each job.

voice.description: Voice id resolved to input/<voice>.mp3 as the cloning reference. Unknown ids fall back to the workflow's default reference audio.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier in the OpenAI 0.25-4.0 range. Mapped to the WAS time-stretch node, which keeps the original pitch.

instructions.description: OpenAI TTS style instructions, mapped to the VoxCPM voice_design prompt (natural-language voice description).

prompt_text.description: Transcript of the reference audio used for cloning. Keep it in sync when switching voice; omit to keep the workflow's baked-in transcript.
